data.narrative:
Primoco UAV is a public-stage defense and security company founded by Ladislav Semetkovský, currently operating with a €44M+ orderbook. The valuation universe comprises 22 same-sector peers, including 2 publicly traded comparables (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private firms spanning the defense tech ecosystem, such as Anduril Industries, Helsing, Shield AI, and Evolv Technology.

Peer-median valuation proved inapplicable due to insufficient narrow-stage comparables. The analysis identified only one same-stage peer within Defense & Security, falling substantially short of the three-datapoint threshold required for reliable peer triangulation. Expanding to adjacent-stage or similar-valuation-tier peers yielded no additional matches, and broadening to all 22 sector participants would introduce excessive heterogeneity across business models, maturity levels, and revenue profiles. This data constraint precludes a defensible multiples-based range.

The €44M+ orderbook provides a baseline reference point but remains insufficient alone to establish enterprise value without revenue recognition data, cash conversion timelines, or comparable gross margins. Material uncertainties include the timing and conversion of backlog into revenue, the target's current EBITDA or net loss profile relative to public comparables, and differentiation within the crowded defense-tech landscape. A credible valuation would require either: expanding the comparable set through adjacent defense subsectors, obtaining private transaction precedents, or applying discounted cash flow analysis anchored to orderbook conversion assumptions.
